readme.title: DS1 Triple Randomizer - Support bundle
readme.what: This archive was made by DS1 Triple Randomizer so that someone can help with a problem. Nothing was sent anywhere: you chose where to save it and you decide who receives it. Open summary.txt first.

files.summary: a readable summary of the application, the game and your last world
files.diagnostics: the same information as structured data (versions, Seed Code, settings, retries, timings)
files.generation: the run manifest with the package file hashes, a summary of the last operations and the validation reason codes
files.logs: the newest lines of the application log, the backend log and the log of the last randomization
files.release: the build information (version, commit, signature state)

readme.never: What is never in it: your Dark Souls Remastered files or any file generated from them, executables, certificates or keys, environment variables, passwords, tokens, cookies, browser data, or the folder of your game.
readme.redaction: Before saving, the application removed your Windows user name, your computer name, the folders of your profile, the application data, the temporary folder and the game folder (they appear as <USER>, <HOST>, <USER_DATA>, <TEMP> and <GAME_DIR>), as well as passwords, tokens, keys, cookies, e-mail and network addresses. The Seed Code and the file hashes are kept on purpose. Look through the files if you want to check.
readme.reproduce: To recreate the same world: use Load seed with the Seed Code in summary.txt. The generation profile and the versions are in diagnostics.json.

ui.failed: The support bundle could not be made.
ui.note: A ZIP with a summary, structured diagnostics, the newest log lines and the manifest of your last world. No game files, no personal folders; secrets are removed before saving.
